title: group posture: a member whose session has no active organization gets 500 ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED on a tenant-scoped create, where isolated answers 403 naming the missing organization
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect with a reproduction (QA-measured on a walled boot, confirmed by an independent RUNNER rule 7 re-derivation).

Path: access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics
QA-source: #24783 · access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics · acceptance[1] (also acceptance[5], acceptance[6], negative[3])
Checklist item priority: P0 (clause fails, so the card inherits P0 under the filing gate's tri-state rule)
type: Bug

reach: measured through the public HTTP door at framework 580fd4ed: on an `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group` boot, `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` from a member of organization A whose session has `activeOrganizationId: null` answers `500 {"error":"Internal server error","code":"ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED"}`. Reproduced twice by the runner and twice by a second agent on fresh boots.

## What happens

On a walled `group` boot, a user who belongs to an organization but whose session has no active organization sends a create on a tenant-scoped object. The Layer 0 wall lets the session write through. The engine then infers "system write" from the missing `tenantId`, and refuses with `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError`, whose status is fixed at 500. The REST layer logs it as `[REST] Unhandled error`.

Nothing is written: no row, no NULL `organization_id`, so the failure is closed. The defect is the answer.

- The same steps on `isolated` answer `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` "[Security] Access denied: 'showcase_task' is scoped to an organization, and this session has no active organization — so this insert has no organization to place the record in. Join or select an active organization and retry."
- A user with no membership at all gets that same 403 on `group` too.

## Reproduction

The boot is a walled scratch app: a copy of examples/app-showcase whose own package.json declares `@objectstack/organizations` (installed there), run from that copy with:
- `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group`
- `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`
- `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`
- `os dev --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:RUNDIR/grp.db`

Steps:
1. As the operator `admin@objectos.ai`, call `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user {"email":"qa-a@wall.test","password":"Passw0rd!x1","name":"A"}`. Sign in as the new user, call `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`, then sign in again to get token T.
2. As T, call `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create {"name":"qa-org-a","slug":"qa-org-a"}`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active {"organizationId":"ORG_A"}`.
3. As T, create `showcase_account {"name":"a"}`, then `showcase_project {"name":"p","account":"ACCOUNT_ID"}`.
4. As T, call `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active {"organizationId": null}`. `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` now shows `session.activeOrganizationId: null`.
5. As T, call `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task {"title":"x","project":"PROJECT_ID"}`.

Results:
- expected: a 4xx from the closed ADR-0112 vocabulary naming the missing active organization. This is the isolated answer above, and what the checklist clause requires.
- actual: `500 {"error":"Internal server error","code":"ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED"}`, and the log line `[REST] Unhandled error: SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError: Insert on 'showcase_task' was REFUSED: a system-context write on a tenant-scoped object must carry an organization, and this install runs the 'group' tenancy posture …`.

## Mechanism (read at 580fd4ed by the verifying agent)

1. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` `callerHasOrganizationScope` (about :656–663): under a union-scope posture it answers true whenever `accessible_org_ids` is non-empty, regardless of `tenantId`. So `organizationWallRefusal` (about :7850) returns null for a member with no active org, and the ADR-0123 D2 "no active organization" refusal (about :3947–3973) never fires.
2. `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` calls `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` for every insert (about :16301). That function (about :7384) treats "no `execCtx.tenantId`" as a system write. It has no `isSystem` check.
3. `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` (about :366) fixes the error's status at 500. The ledger entry in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (about :776) describes the caller as "server-side automation", not a request.

The write is evaluated as the session: object permissions applied first, and no permission or RLS bypass was observed. Only the error text says "system-context".

## Filing-gate answers

- Category: ① a defect against the declared contract of `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` acceptance[1] ("refused LOUDLY with a 4xx whose message NAMES the missing active organization — not a generic denial, not a 500") and negative[3] ("a 500 … on any of the three paths — the state is declared legal, so crashing is a defect").
- Acting reader: the lane owning the Layer 0 write wall in `packages/plugins/plugin-security` (`domain:security`). Candidate fix: under a union-scope posture, a write also requires an active organization, so it answers the same ADR-0123 D2 403 that `isolated` answers. Alternatively, the engine maps a non-system caller to that refusal instead of the 500.
- Duplicate search (open AND closed), objectstack:
  - "group posture no active organization insert 500 ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED" → 21 hits.
  - "no active organization session write 500 walled group posture member" → 7 hits.
  - None is this defect. The nearest are #21476 (closed: an anonymous public-form submit 500s on a walled posture with the same code, a different caller) and #24343 (open: NULL organization_id rows from framework writers on a walled control plane). Also checked #24543–#24751, this sweep's earlier cards: none.

Found by the 18.0 round-3 walled pass; full evidence is in #24783.
